q.en: Q1. Books sold by four shops (A, B, C, D) in two months: June: A=120, B=150, C=180, D=100. July: A=150, B=200, C=160, D=140. What is the total number of books sold by shop B in both months?

as: B ৰ জুন বিক্ৰী = 150, জুলাই বিক্ৰী = 200।
